theme_archetype.rationale: Legal and corporate platform that requires absolute authority, clarity, and trust. White backgrounds with sharp intense red accents create a 'Swiss Legal' modern aesthetic without feeling dated or overly generic.

typography.heading_strategy: Sharp, clean, tightly tracked for a corporate feel. Use Outfit for modern authority.
typography.body_strategy: IBM Plex Sans brings a subtle document/editorial feel ideal for legal reading.

layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-24 for marketing sections.
layout_spacing.grid_strategy: Control Room grid for Admin Dashboard (dense, functional). Tetris or Bento grid for Marketing pages to maintain visual interest and white space.

motion_interaction.hover_states: Crisp transitions. Buttons: hover:bg-[#B30000]. Cards: subtle lift -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
motion_interaction.page_transitions: Framer Motion fade-in and slide-up (staggered) for marketing sections. Keep admin dashboard instantaneous.

components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary: bg-[#E60000] text-white hover:bg-[#B30000].
components.cards: White background, 1px solid border-gray-200, no drop shadow by default, shadow-lg on hover.

hero_background.description: Abstract minimal architecture with pure white and striking red light accent. Ideal for the main hero section with a gradient overlay.

course_details.description: Elegant legal documents close-up. Use for course details background or decorative element in pillars.

office_contact.description: Modern office table setup. Use for about or contact sections.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute with kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Hybrid app: Marketing Frontend (Home, Courses, Course Detail, Contact) and Admin Dashboard (Login, CRUD Courses, View Messages).
Use standard pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts for asymmetry and breathing room. Use Shadcn components for Admin Dashboard, Tables, and Forms.
Ensure all fonts are imported from Google Fonts (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');).
Do NOT use placeholder images (e.g. via.placeholder.com). Use ONLY the provided image URLs.
Primary red is #E60000. It should be used for main CTAs ('Ver cursos', 'Inscribirme') and visual accents. Never use as a full-screen background.
For the course details page, the 'Inscribirme' CTA should visually stand out and simulate redirect to Hotmart (can just be a link or mock redirect).
Dashboard should include mock functionality or local state to create, edit, delete, and publish courses. Include thumbnail upload (URL).
CRITICAL: The system uses .js and .jsx files. DO NOT output or assume .ts or .tsx files.

pages_to_build.name: Home
pages_to_build.features: Hero with red accents, 'Pilares' section (Actualización legal, Criterio jurídico, etc.), Featured Courses in clean cards.

pages_to_build.name: Courses
pages_to_build.features: List of all courses with legal category filters (Derecho familiar, civil, mercantil, laboral, etc.).

pages_to_build.name: Course Detail
pages_to_build.features: Cover image, description, objective, target audience, syllabus, instructor, duration, large 'Inscribirme' CTA.

pages_to_build.name: Contact
pages_to_build.features: Professional contact form and firm info.

pages_to_build.name: Admin Dashboard
pages_to_build.features: CRUD interface for courses (create, edit, delete, publish/draft, thumbnail URL), and view list of contact messages.
